name: Ōya (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ōya town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised arrowhead.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōya in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 May 1955.

features.role: Ōya town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised arrowhead
